headline: Expected and priced: Novavax's $125M Sanofi milestone, public since 09:40 ET; the stock is -0.2% since
reasoning: Source: Novavax's announcement, relayed by Benzinga Newsdesk 09:40 ET: 'Novavax Earns $125M Milestone Payment With Initiation Of Sanofi's Phase 3 Influence-COVID-19 Combination Vaccine Study Through Nuvaxovid'.
What changed: $125M of cash, about 7% of the $1.72B market cap. The milestone was a scheduled term of the 2024 Sanofi agreement, triggered by a trial start the market expected.
Move: 10.405 vs 10.425 before the item, -0.19%, range 10.29-10.53 on 90,333 IEX shares over three hours. Q3 results come on November 5.
objections: A scheduled milestone the market has had three hours to price; no reaction.
